test.title: Mini-test · A city learns to live with floods

paragraphs.text: When the river burst its banks in 2014, more than 3,000 homes in the city of Marbury were flooded. Many residents were unable to return for over a year, and small businesses in the old town suffered the greatest losses.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The city’s first response was to build higher walls along the river. The walls protected the centre during the next major flood in 2019, but water was pushed downstream, where two villages were flooded for the first time.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: This led the regional authority to change its approach. Instead of only building walls, it bought farmland upstream and allowed it to flood during storms, storing water that would otherwise reach the city.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Inside the city, new rules require that the ground floors of new buildings be used for garages, shops or storage rather than bedrooms. Existing homeowners can receive grants to install waterproof doors and to move electrical sockets higher up the walls.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Residents’ attitudes have also changed. A survey found that the share of households with a flood plan rose from one in ten before 2014 to more than half today. The city now sends text warnings to anyone who registers.
paragraphs.label: E

document.title: Mini-test · A city learns to live with floods

items.quote: Many residents were unable to return for over a year
items.prompt: Many residents whose homes flooded in 2014
keywords: unable to return for over a year

explanation.en: “Many residents were unable to return for over a year” → J. Moving to the countryside (L) is not mentioned.
explanation.kk: «Many residents were unable to return for over a year» → J. Ауылға көшу (L) мәтінде аталмайды.
explanation.ru: «Many residents were unable to return for over a year» → J. L про переезд в деревню в тексте не упоминается.

items.quote: small businesses in the old town suffered the greatest losses
items.prompt: Small businesses in the old town

explanation.en: Small businesses were hit hardest in 2014: “small businesses in the old town suffered the greatest losses” → C.
explanation.kk: 2014 жылғы тасқыннан шағын кәсіпорындар бәрінен көп зардап шеккен: «small businesses in the old town suffered the greatest losses» → C.
explanation.ru: Больше всех от наводнения 2014 года пострадали малые предприятия: «small businesses in the old town suffered the greatest losses» → C.

items.quote: water was pushed downstream, where two villages were flooded for the first time
items.prompt: The higher walls along the river

explanation.en: The walls saved the centre but pushed water downstream, flooding villages for the first time → A. I describes the villages, not the walls.
explanation.kk: Қабырға орталықты қорғады, бірақ су төменге ағып, бұрын су баспаған ауылдарды басты → A. I қабырғаны емес, ауылдардың өзін сипаттайды.
explanation.ru: Стены защитили центр, но вода ушла вниз по реке и затопила деревни, где раньше наводнений не было → A. I описывает сами деревни, а не стены.

items.quote: where two villages were flooded for the first time

explanation.en: The villages downstream “were flooded for the first time” in the 2019 flood → I.
explanation.kk: Төменгі ағыстағы ауылдарды 2019 жылғы тасқында «were flooded for the first time» → I.
explanation.ru: Деревни ниже по течению «were flooded for the first time» во время наводнения 2019 года → I.

items.quote: Instead of only building walls, it bought farmland upstream

explanation.en: “Instead of only building walls, it bought farmland upstream” — the authority stopped relying only on walls → H.
explanation.kk: «Instead of only building walls, it bought farmland upstream» — билік тек қабырғаға сенбеуді шешкен → H.
explanation.ru: «Instead of only building walls, it bought farmland upstream» — власти решили не полагаться только на стены → H.

items.quote: allowed it to flood during storms, storing water that would otherwise reach the city

explanation.en: The land floods during storms, “storing water that would otherwise reach the city” → D. “Hold water” = “storing water”.
explanation.kk: Жерді дауыл кезінде су бастырады, «storing water that would otherwise reach the city» → D. «Hold water» = «storing water».
explanation.ru: Землю затапливают в шторм, «storing water that would otherwise reach the city» → D. «Hold water» = «storing water».

items.quote: the ground floors of new buildings be used for garages, shops or storage rather than bedrooms

explanation.en: Ground floors must be “garages, shops or storage rather than bedrooms” → B: no sleeping downstairs.
explanation.kk: Жаңа үйлердің бірінші қабаты — «garages, shops or storage rather than bedrooms» → B: төменде ұйықтауға болмайды.
explanation.ru: Первые этажи новых домов — «garages, shops or storage rather than bedrooms» → B: спать внизу нельзя.

items.quote: Existing homeowners can receive grants to install waterproof doors

explanation.en: “Existing homeowners can receive grants” → E. Free sandbags (F) are not mentioned.
explanation.kk: «Existing homeowners can receive grants» → E. Құм қапшығы (F) мәтінде жоқ.
explanation.ru: «Existing homeowners can receive grants» → E. F про мешки с песком в тексте нет.

items.quote: the share of households with a flood plan rose from one in ten before 2014 to more than half today
items.prompt: The share of households with a flood plan

explanation.en: The share of households with a plan “rose from one in ten before 2014 to more than half today” → K.
explanation.kk: Жоспары бар отбасылардың үлесі «rose from one in ten before 2014 to more than half today» → K.
explanation.ru: Доля семей с планом «rose from one in ten before 2014 to more than half today» → K.

items.quote: The city now sends text warnings to anyone who registers
items.prompt: People who register with the city

explanation.en: The city texts people who sign up: “The city now sends text warnings to anyone who registers” → G.
explanation.kk: Тіркелгендерге қала SMS жібереді: «The city now sends text warnings to anyone who registers» → G.
explanation.ru: Тем, кто зарегистрировался, город шлёт SMS: «The city now sends text warnings to anyone who registers» → G.
